name: PAK'nSAVE Receipt
description: This receipt is issued by PAK'nSAVE and identifies the transaction as originating from PAK'nSAVE Westgate, 124–26 Don Buck Road, Westgate, Auckland. The receipt documents a Gift Station gift-card activation transaction and includes store branding, location details, a contact telephone number, terminal identifier, transaction number, transaction timestamp, masked card number, sale identifier, and activation amount. The receipt also records an Incorrect PIN message indicating that the entered PIN did not match during the transaction process. The footer contains the cashier name, GST registration number, tax-inclusive pricing notice, purchase conditions, and the official PAK'nSAVE website. The overall layout is representative of a New Zealand supermarket POS receipt, combining gift-card activation processing, GST-compliant reporting, transaction controls, and retail payment documentation within a compact receipt format.
